services.title: What I can build for your business
services.intro: I handle the whole process: product, technical design, development, testing and release on the App Store and Google Play.

items.title: Mobile apps from scratch
items.description: Native iOS and Android apps from a single Flutter codebase. Clean architecture, ready to scale and published on the stores.

items.title: Improvement & maintenance
items.description: I rescue, optimize and maintain existing apps: performance, stability, SDK upgrades and new features without breaking what already works.

items.title: Payments & video calls
items.description: Stripe payment integrations and real-time video calls with Agora, proven in production with thousands of users.

items.title: Websites & e-commerce
items.description: Fast websites and online stores built with Next.js, optimized for SEO and for turning visitors into customers.

projects.title: Products I've taken to production
projects.intro: A selection of apps and sites I've worked on, from the first commit to the store.

buzzstar.name: BuzzStar
buzzstar.description: Real-time video calls between content creators and their fans. I implemented the Stripe payment flow, integrated low-latency video calls with Agora and improved the production app's performance.

parlor.name: Parlor Games
parlor.description: Prediction games for NFL, NBA and NCAA matches with real-time scoreboards. I built it from scratch through release on the App Store and Google Play.

kiiwi.name: Kiiwi
kiiwi.description: Last-minute deals from local businesses. I built it from scratch and released it on both stores.

unwrap.name: Unwrap
unwrap.description: Gift lists, events and friend groups. I developed and maintained features with GraphQL and Firebase for iOS and Android.

inkedsports.name: Inked Sports
inkedsports.description: Connects US college athletes with brands. I implemented a BLoC architecture, consumed GraphQL services, integrated Firebase and shipped the app to iOS and Android.

carmessie.name: Carmessie Velvet
carmessie.description: Mexican fashion e-commerce with pre-order sales.

about.title: Solid engineering, focused on the product
paragraphs: I'm a mobile developer with almost 7 years of experience, more than 5 of them building products for the US market. I enjoy taking an idea and turning it into a stable, fast app that's ready to grow.
I work with Clean Architecture, Riverpod and BLoC, write tests, and automate builds and releases with CI/CD (Codemagic, Fastlane and GitHub Actions).
I use Claude Code with agents and skills to speed up development without compromising code quality.
